info.description:
Unofficial Google Photos command line interface.

      This .NET global tool wraps the CasCap.Api.GooglePhotos library to upload media items to, and
      manage albums in, a Google Photos account.

      Since Google's API change of 31 March 2025 the Library API only exposes albums and media items
      created by the calling application, so this tool only lists and downloads content it uploaded.

      For usage examples see the docs on github, https://github.com/f2calv/CasCap.GooglePhotosCli

commands.name: albums
commands.description: Manage albums created by this tool.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download the media items of an album created by this tool.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Create the output directory without prompting.

options.name: --maxwidth
options.description:
Scale the image with this max width, preserving the aspect
ratio.

options.name: --maxheight
options.description: Scale the image with this max height, preserving the aspect

options.name: --crop
options.description:
Crop the image to the exact values of max width and max
height.

options.name: --exif
options.description:
Download the image retaining all the EXIF metadata except the
location metadata.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Re-download the media item even if it exists locally.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List albums created by this tool.

options.name: --duplicates
options.description: Show only albums which share a title with another album.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Sign out by deleting the locally cached OAuth credentials.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Delete the cached credentials without prompting.

commands.name: mediaitems
commands.description: Manage media items created by this tool.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List media items created by this tool.

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload media items to your Google Photos account.

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to media item or folder root.

options.name: --pattern
options.description:
Inclusive folder wildcard filter (defaults to all Google
supported extensions).
Default value is: *.*.

options.name: --delete
options.description: Delete the local media file after a successful upload.

options.name: --title
options.description: Upload into the album with this title.

options.name: --hierarchy
options.description: Upload into albums named after the source folder names.

commands.name: Remarks
commands.description:
Since Google's API change of 31 March 2025 this tool can only list, download and organise
albums and media items which it created itself. Existing media in your account is not visible.
